#work #admin

Kargolo expense rules, my cheat sheet of the March 2025 version (the PDF is 14 pages, nobody reads it).

- Card: Payhawk card for everything work-related. Personal card only if Payhawk is declined, then claim it.
- Claims within 30 days, after that Marloes in Finance can say no (and does).
- Receipt photo needed above €25. Below that, a note in Payhawk is enough.
- Train over plane for anything under 700 km. Amsterdam to Berlin = train, always. Interrail-style passes are fine if cheaper, see [[Rail pass Europe]].
- Hotels: cap €165/night in Amsterdam, Berlin, London. €140/night elsewhere. Over the cap needs Henk.
- Daily allowance when travelling: €45, no receipts needed for food then.
- Team dinners: €55 per head incl. drinks, alcohol max 1/3 of the bill.
- Approval: own manager up to €500, Henk above €500, CFO above €5,000.
- Offsites get their own cost code, OFF-2025-Q3 for the June one, see [[Q3 planning offsite]].
- Home office: one-time €400 for a chair or desk, plus €2.35 per working day from home (paid with salary, not claimed). Tax side of that in [[Home office deduction]].
- Conference tickets: from the team training budget, €1,500 per person per year.
- Not covered: parking fines, minibar, upgrades, the gym at the hotel.
